contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [DN G]RATIAN VS AVGG AVG ; R/ [SECURITAS REI PV]BLICAE

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Gratian (367-383), Victory left issue of 367-378, Reece period 19. Possibly Lyon mint, RIC volume 9 no. 21(b), issue of 367-375. Chipped. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right; youthful portrait part turned towards viewer. Obverse inscription: [DN G]RATIAN VS AVGG AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm, bar to upper left; mintmarks in field: OF[L] branch [R]. Reverse inscription: [SECURITAS REI PV]BLICAE. In exergue: probably LVGP. Diameter: 17.2mm, Weight: 2.54gms, die axis: 6
